You should break this into a couple separate posts for each issue (or comment on/upvote related ones) as it makes it easier for devs to track and fix each problem.

As for existing ones:

- [Controller Offsets](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/wrist-rotation-and-position-off-on-multible-axies-reguardless-of-legacy-fingers)

- [Physbone Posing issues](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/1491-vive-controllers-physbone-pose-w-trigger-full-pull-is-unintuitive)

Legacy finger tracking doesn't really have anything to do with our vive wands since we didn't have finger tracking before. If you'd like to disable skeletal input you can head into the nain menu -> settings -> controls -> disable "avatars use finger tracking"

details:
Vive controls have been absolutely broken since the last update. Below are descriptions of issues encountered using the official bindings.

Issues experienced on: Vive Pro, wired, through SteamVR, using Vive Wands. Windows 10, VRChat build 1493.

# The position of the avatar's hands relative to the controllers has been changed

While subtle, the offset is very off-putting for players with many hours. This changes the way the avatar *feels*. This appears to have affected other controller types as well.

# Physbones currently cannot be grabbed or posed properly with the default bindings

**Previous behaviour:** You could grab a physbone using Trigger, and pose it in place using Grip. This was perfectly fine and intuitive.

**New behaviour:** Physbones cannot be grabbed. Pressing Trigger will instead pose them in place without grabbing them. This is because the "interact" binding, which is used to pose physbones, is bound to Trigger as well. A separate "pose" binding would solve this issue.

**Current workaround:** A way around this is to bind the "interact" button to the Grip, which makes the old behaviour work again, but also means that interacting with any in-world UI or element requires pressing Grip instead of Trigger, which is confusing, especially because it conflicts with the VRChat UI, which still uses Trigger - just like every other VR game.

# Trackpad movement deadzone is awful, causing slow walking

**Old behaviour:** Pressing down anywhere on the Left Trackpad would make the player walk at full speed.

**New behaviour:** Now, the movement changes according to how far you're pressing down the edge of the Left Trackpad, which allows for more precision, but walking at full speed requires pressing on the *very edge* of the Trackpad, which is uncomfortable and un-intuitive.

**Current workaround:** Changing the deadzone in the bindings.

# Personal mirror movement has changed, causing input conflicts

**Old behaviour:** Adjusting the personal mirror in "Immersive Mode" requires to point at it, press down Trigger, and move it around by *touching* up or down on the Trackpad, without actually *clicking*.

**New behaviour:** Now, you need to do the same as above and PRESS down on the trackpad. This causes the avatar to jump when trying to move the personal mirror.

# Enabling the legacy hands system in the wheel menu doesn't change ANYTHING

As described above

# In the current open beta, pressing down on Right Trigger does a "Point" gesture instead of a closed hand

As described above, this only occurs on the right hand on any avatars, no matter the bindings used
title: Vive wand bindings absolutely broken since last update
